answer: A joiner cuts one marble pass bound to its payer and parks 2,250 POA idle 24 epochs. Coins rest on a mesa, a high shelf unlocked after 11 live epochs. Each round: 42s unique 40-byte proof; six auditors from a public witness reef have 75s to replay two prior proofs and flag copies or a shared funder. Miss, clone, or early cash-out burns 610 POA, dumps the mesa to jurors, exiles the key 19 epochs. Cost: 2,250 POA plus 11 rounds before first coin; 800 fakes lock 1.8 million POA vs ~140 never reached. Hole: rented passes; marble credentials sharing a payer lose every unfinished mesa on that reef.
